chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When a man sneezes during his prayer, let him praise Allah.
ai.seo_question: What should a Muslim say if they sneeze while performing prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi through the chain of Hammad ibn al-Halabi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the Sunnah of saying 'Alhamdulillah' upon sneezing during prayer, distinguishing it from the response to the sneezer. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on maintaining ritual continuity and acknowledging divine blessings even during minor interruptions in worship. It reflects the broader jurisprudential principle that personal acts of remembrance do not invalidate the prayer unless they involve excessive speech or movement.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the man sneezes during his Salāt, so let him Praise Allahazwj’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
In case of sneezing in Salah (prayer) one should say, ‘Tahmid, (all praise belongs to Allah).”
